links.outcome: Readability of LLM responses (Flesch Reading Ease, Flesch-Kincaid Grade Level) versus guidelines
links.effect: BOS and AAO were more readable than the LLMs. ChatGPT 4.0 was the most readable LLM but was still found to be difficult for readers.
links.quote: BOS and AAO were more readable than the LLMs.

links.outcome: Accuracy and completeness of LLM nutritional advice versus AAO and BOS guidelines
links.effect: LLM responses were compatible with the guidelines, but detailed information on tooth decay, dental plaque and risks of acidic environments was inadequate. DISCERN scores showed no significant difference between sources.
links.quote: Responses of LLMs were understandable and compatible with the guidelines, but detailed information on tooth decay, dental plaque and risks of acidic environments were inadequate.

screen.reason: Empirical benchmark evaluating LLM-generated patient nutritional advice against orthodontic professional guidelines using DISCERN and readability metrics, without testing an organizational deployment safeguard or practice.
